caption: The model wears a dark green, button-up, long-sleeved jacket with a collar and two chest pockets. The sleeves are three-quarter length, fitting loosely around the arms. Beneath the jacket, the model has on a pair of black and blue plaid cargo shorts with multiple pockets and a relaxed fit. The shorts extend to mid-thigh, providing a casual look.

The model wears a dark blue, ribbed, long-sleeved sweater that extends to the upper thighs. The sleeves are long and slightly loose, with a straight cut. Beneath the sweater, the model has on a pair of patterned shorts that are knee-length and have a loose fit. The pattern on the shorts consists of a mix of dark and light colors, creating a subtle camouflage effect.

The model wears a blue and beige patterned sleeveless upper garment, featuring a relaxed fit with a straight neckline and no collar. The lower garment consists of brown plaid shorts that extend to mid-thigh, with a straight leg structure. The overall look is casual and summery, suitable for warm weather.

The model wears a dark green, ribbed sweater that covers the entire body, extending down to the ankles. The sweater features long, loose sleeves with a relaxed fit. Beneath the sweater, the model has on a pair of black pants with a subtle pattern, which are long and straight, fitting snugly around the legs.

The model wears a teal, sleeveless top with a square neckline and a tied waist, creating a fitted look. The top is made of a smooth, lightweight fabric and extends to the mid-thigh. Beneath the top, the model has on a dark green, pleated skirt that reaches just above the knees, giving it a flared silhouette. The skirt is made of a flowing, slightly sheer material, adding a touch of elegance to the outfit.

The model wears a green, knitted wholebody garment, specifically a poncho-style cape that extends down to the upper thighs. It features long, loose, straight sleeves and a V-neck collar. Beneath the poncho, the model has on a short, wide pair of purple shorts as the lower garment, and a short, normal white and black patterned upper garment that appears to be a bra top.

The model wears a vibrant teal, button-up dress that reaches the ankles, featuring a V-neckline and a fitted waist. The sleeves are three-quarter length, slightly puffed at the shoulders, and end just above the elbows. The skirt has a flared hem, creating a gentle A-line silhouette. Underneath the dress, the model has on a dark olive-green, ruffled skirt that adds volume and texture to the ensemble.

The model wears a light green, loose-fitting T-shirt with a relaxed fit and a straight neckline. The T-shirt is paired with a long, wide, brown pair of trousers that extend to the ankles, featuring straight legs. The overall look is casual and comfortable, suitable for everyday wear.

The model wears a light green, long-sleeved dress that falls just above the knees. The dress features a straight hem and a crew neck. The sleeves are long and loose, with a straight structure. The dress is the only garment visible on the model, as it covers the entire body.

The model wears a deep blue, layered dress with a structured bodice and a flared skirt. The dress features a V-neckline with a decorative button detail at the center front. The sleeves are short and puffed, adding volume to the upper part of the garment. The skirt is long, with multiple ruffled layers that create a full, voluminous silhouette. The overall style is elegant and romantic, suitable for formal occasions.
